extensionDescription.message: Process a URL queue, generate a distinct contextual comment for each target, submit it, and verify the result.

loginRequiredDescription.message: Log in on this page, then run the assistant again.

noCommentForm.message: No supported comment form was found on this page.

commentFailed.message: The comment could not be submitted

missingSettings.message: Complete the required settings in the dashboard first (provider API key and promoting site).

invalidWebsiteUrl.message: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS website URL.

websiteProfileFailed.message: The promoted website must expose both a Meta Title and Meta Description.

missingDeepSeekApiKey.message: Add a DeepSeek API key for the selected model.

missingKieApiKey.message: Add a KIE API key for the selected model.

dashboardOpenFailed.message: The dashboard could not be opened

settingsDescription.message: Add provider keys, choose a model, and pick the interface language. Promoted websites live under Websites.

websiteFieldMissing.message: No website field; the link can be placed naturally in the draft

captchaRequiredDescription.message: Complete the CAPTCHA on the page, then scan again. The assistant will not bypass it.

draftHint.message: Review and edit this comment before publishing it.

submitConfirmation.message: This action fills the form and clicks the page's submit button.

submissionUnconfirmed.message: Unable to confirm whether the server accepted the comment. It will not be submitted again.

permissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted for the website origin.

apiKeySecurityNote.message: Keys are stored locally in this Chrome profile and sent only to the selected provider.

pageChangedSinceGeneration.message: The active page or comment form changed after this draft was generated. Generate a new draft before submitting.

invalidTargetUrls.message: Check the target URLs. Use up to 200 complete HTTP or HTTPS URLs.

stopBatchHint.message: Stopping prevents future submissions. Comments already submitted are not undone.

batchPausedLoginDescription.message: The batch is paused. Log in on the open target page, then continue, or skip this target.

batchPausedCaptchaDescription.message: The batch is paused. Complete the CAPTCHA on the open target page, then continue, or skip this target.

batchSkippedLoginDescription.message: This target was skipped because it requires login.

batchSkippedCaptchaDescription.message: This target was skipped because it requires a CAPTCHA.

sitesPageDescription.message: Keep the profile of every website you promote, and set the anchor text mix its links should follow.

sitesDefaultHint.message: The side panel and new plans start from this website.

sitesAnchorMixUnavailable.message: Anchor text only applies when the link goes into the comment body. Switch to that placement to set a mix.

crossOriginCommentFrameUnsupported.message: This comment widget is hosted on another origin and requires manual posting.

targetPageUnreachable.message: The page did not load — the site may be down, blocked, or too slow to reach.

displayNameRequiredForTarget.message: This form requires a display name. Add one in the dashboard's settings before the next batch.

emailRequiredForTarget.message: This form requires an email. Add one in the dashboard's settings before the next batch.

formNeedsReview.message: A possible form was found, but its fields could not be mapped safely. Nothing was submitted.

requiredFieldNotMapped.message: This form has a required field the extension cannot fill safely. Nothing was submitted.

websiteRequiredForTarget.message: This form requires a website URL. Nothing was submitted.

commentBodyLinkRequired.message: Pre-submit link validation failed: the promoted link is missing from the comment body or does not match the configured website URL. Check the protocol, host, and path.

unsafeSubmitBlocked.message: The selected action was blocked because it was not a safe comment submission. Nothing was submitted.

commentFormRevealed.message: AI identified and opened the control that reveals the comment form.

commentFormRevealDispatched.message: AI identified the control that reveals the comment form and is opening it.

backgroundWorkerNotice.message: Runs in a background tab group without switching pages

generatedCommentCopyFailed.message: The comment could not be copied

diagnosticsCopyFailed.message: The diagnostic could not be copied

activityWaitingForPage.message: Waiting for the page to finish loading

activityAnalyzingContent.message: Reading the article and comment area

commentPublishedByAnchor.message: Verified from the new comment link on the page.

commentPublishedByFingerprint.message: Verified from the rendered comment text on the page.

commentPendingWordPressModeration.message: The site accepted the comment and marked it for moderation.

commentPendingModerationFeedback.message: The page reports that the comment is awaiting moderation.

commentPublishedByPublicCheck.message: Confirmed by an anonymous read: the comment and its link are public.

commentAcceptedAwaitingPublicCheck.message: The site accepted the comment; checking whether it is publicly visible.

commentAcceptedNotPublicYet.message: The site accepted the comment, but no anonymous visitor can see it yet.

commentPublicCheckInconclusive.message: The page could not be read anonymously. It will be rechecked later.

commentNotPublic.message: An anonymous read of the page does not find this comment.

commentPublicLinkStripped.message: The comment is public, but its link was removed.

anchorMixDescription.message: Set the share each kind of anchor text should hold for this site. Every published link is counted, and the next one is drawn from whichever kind is furthest behind its share.

anchorMixPoolEmpty.message: Add wording here, or this kind is skipped.

anchorMixFillBareUrlUnavailable.message: Set the website URL above first.

anchorMixGenerateNaturalNeedsUrl.message: Fill in the website URL and save the site first, then generate.

anchorMixGenerateNaturalNeedsPermission.message: Access to your own website is needed to read its title and description.

anchorMixGenerateNaturalNeedsApiKey.message: Add the API key for the selected model in Settings first.

anchorMixGenerateNaturalSiteUnreachable.message: Could not read the website. Check that the URL opens and its home page has a title and description.

anchorMixGenerateNaturalFailed.message: Could not write fallback wording. Check the provider API key and the website URL.

anchorMixNaturalHint.message: Written fresh for each comment so it fits the sentence. These entries are only the fallback when that is unusable — leave them empty and this kind is skipped.

anchorTextsUntracked.message: $1 more were published without a recorded wording.

anchorMixSaveFailed.message: Could not save the anchor mix.

anchorBucketNakedHint.message: The address itself, shown as the link text.

anchorBucketExactHint.message: The keyword you are targeting, word for word.

anchorBucketGenericHint.message: Wording that names no keyword at all.

anchorBucketNaturalHint.message: A phrase that belongs to the sentence around it.

batchIdleDescription.message: Runs are started from a plan in the dashboard. This panel follows progress and handles login and CAPTCHA stops.

resumeStoppedBatchHint.message: Resuming picks up the targets this run has not finished. A comment that was already submitted is never sent twice.
